summary: An intense tornado caused significant damage in east central Florence. The tornado started in Rappahannock County north of Waffleburg and moved southeast. The tornado crossed the Rappahannock River into Richmond County, causing EF3 level damage in Henrico City. The tornado continued southeast into Halifax County, where it dissipated.
A brief tornado caused minor damage in Lake and Syracuse counties.
A waterspout came ashore in Midland County, causing minor damage.

A strong mountaintop tornado caused EF4 damage throughout northern Florence. The tornado started in central Autauga County and moved east, crossing Interstate 85 and into Tunkhannock County. The tornado then crossed the Rappahannock River, through rural parts of New James City and Spotsylvania, causing 3 deaths and 5 injuries. The tornado continued east and dissipated in western Pittsylvania County.
A weak tornado caused one injury and minor daamge along the Tulpehocken River in Greene and Mahantango counties.
An EF1 tornado caused significant tree damage along the Greene County/Luke County border.

A violent tornado caused significant damage across Aqualand and Iredale. This long-tracked tornado started in southwestern Floyd County, causing significant damage to forests. The tornado continued east through rural Floyd, Union, and Dare counties before entering Conneaut County, Aqualand. The tornado carved directly through the town of Sundansbury, causing 3 deaths and at least 20 injuries. The tornado dissipated on the Pymatuning River east of town.

A violent tornado caused significant damage throughout Iredale and Valencia. This extremely long-tracked tornado, crossing over 100 miles, started in Northumberland County, VA, and moved northeast. The tornado moved through rural Potter and Tioga counties before crossing into Iredale. The tornado moved directly through the town of Moshannon, causing almost EF5 level damage.
A tornado caused tree damage in southwestern Iredale. No structure damage, injuries, or fatalities were reported.

An extremely violent tornado obliterated the city of Vernontown in southwestern Seyounby-Sy County. This tornado started in southeastern Eastman County, causing little damage. Almost all of the damage was observed within Vernontown. This tornado was likely EF5 for a long time, but damage of this magnitude was only observed within the city limits of Vernontown. Otherwise, tens of thousands of trees were debarked in Seyounby-Sy County.
A QLCS tornado produced minor damage throughout Itasca County.
A QLCS tornado caused minor damage across the Iredale/Orbisonia border.
